name: FMA: A Dataset for Music Analysis
description: FMA (Free Music Archive) is an open music analysis and information retrieval benchmark. Comprising 106,574 full-length audio tracks (343 days of audio) from 16,341 artists across 161 musical genres, it includes pre-extracted audio features, full track metadata, tags, and hierarchical genre labels. Provided in standard subsets (fma_small: 8,000 clips; fma_medium: 25,000 clips; fma_large: 106,574 clips; and fma_full), it benchmarks music genre classification, retrieval, and auto-tagging.
